author: 夜野しずく

en.title: Winter Migrant, Traversing the Mapless Sky
en.premise: From my grandfather's belongings I discover a "secret map" that sketches an unfamiliar coastline. It points to a place the grandfather once journeyed to while chasing migratory birds—a location absent from any ordinary map. I set out to follow its trail, as if to set the frozen moments of my life in motion. Guided by the cold sea breeze and the pale winter light, I gather scattered fragments of lost memories.

zh.title: 冬季的迁徙鸟，行走于无图的天空
zh.premise: 在祖父的遗物中，我发现了一张描绘陌生海岸线的“秘密地图”。那是祖父曾追逐迁徙鸟而踏足、地图上根本没有标记的地方。我开始沿着地图的指引前行，仿佛要让停滞的时间重新流动。在寒冷的海风和淡淡的冬光的指引下，我拾起散落的记忆碎片。
